manifest.title_fil: Hanapin ang patakaran sa IPC ng BHS
objectives_fil: Punan ang policy at training checklist ng BHS: lokasyon, bersiyon, responsable, tungkulin at kulang na training.
objectives_en: Complete a BHS policy and training checklist with location, version, owner, role and training gaps.

sections.takeaway_fil: Punan ang sample policy at training checklist. Tukuyin ang lumang gabay, kulang na contact at dalawang gawain na kailangan ng specialist staff.
sections.takeaway_en: Complete the sample policy and training checklist. Identify old guidance, a missing contact and two tasks requiring specialist staff.

sections.takeaway_fil: Unang hakbang ang pagkakita; kumpirmahin kung sino ang gumagawa ng sterilization at anong training ang kailangan.
sections.takeaway_en: Finding the policy is a first step; confirm who does sterilization and what training it needs.

check.prompt_fil: Nakita ni Nilo ang sterilization policy. Ano ang ibig sabihin nito?
check.prompt_en: Nilo finds a sterilization policy. What does that mean?

options.fil: Puwede na siyang mag-sterilize kahit walang training.
options.en: He may sterilize equipment without training.

options.fil: Kumpleto na agad ang lahat ng IPC training niya.
options.en: All his IPC training is automatically complete.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi nagbibigay ng awtorisasyon ang pagkakita sa papel. 2: Hindi ito katumbas ng practice o observed competence. 3: Unang hakbang ang pagkakita; kumpirmahin kung sino ang gumagawa ng sterilization at anong training ang kailangan.
check.feedback_en: 1: Finding a document does not grant authorization. 2: It is not equivalent to practice or observed competence. 3: Finding the policy is a first step; confirm who does sterilization and what training it needs.

sections.takeaway_fil: Itala ang nakita at nakumpirma; huwag markahang tapos ang training na hindi pa nagagawa.
sections.takeaway_en: Record what is found and confirmed; never mark unfinished training as done.

sections.takeaway_fil: Hindi awtorisasyon ang pagbabasa o attendance; iulat agad ang exposure.
sections.takeaway_en: Reading or attendance is not authorization; report exposures promptly.

sections.takeaway_fil: Nililinaw ang kasalukuyang naaangkop na gabay.

check.prompt_fil: Magkaiba ang lumang poster at bagong instruction. Ano ang gagawin?
check.prompt_en: An old poster conflicts with a newer instruction. What should happen?

options.fil: Piliin ang mas madaling sundin kahit hindi pa malinaw.
options.en: Choose whichever is easier despite the uncertainty.

options.fil: Markahang kumpleto ang checklist upang hindi na magtanong.
options.en: Mark the checklist complete to avoid asking.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Nililinaw ang kasalukuyang naaangkop na gabay. 2: Maaaring hindi angkop o ligtas ang napiling instruction. 3: Itinatago nito ang tunay na kakulangan.
check.feedback_en: 1: This clarifies the applicable guidance. 2: The selected instruction may be inappropriate or unsafe. 3: This conceals the actual gap.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ipasuri sa supervisor ang checklist bago gamitin sa BHS.
sections.takeaway_en: Have the supervisor review the checklist before using it at the BHS.
